smell_validity.evidence: The deliberately anemic Site record is surrounded by four collaborator modules re-deriving knowledge that belongs with it: filename prefix matching in registry and all three editor loops, path joins, content load/store, and .conf/.disabled parsing in editor, presenters and get_domain. One coherent story with correctly excluded /config endpoints; the defensible DTO-plus-services shape keeps it short of reference quality.

maintenance_impact.evidence: Every site-file convention - enabled-encoding suffix, prefix matching, path, timestamp - is duplicated across registry, editor, presenters and endpoints, so convention changes need synchronized multi-file edits with silent divergence on untested paths (multi-prefix matches, enable-on-enabled). Restoring single ownership around the record clears a lasting trap, though confined to a small app.

development_plausibility.evidence: Mirrors a recognizable stalled mid-refactor: data extracted first, behavior deferred, preserving the prototype's quirks (startswith matching, no early exit in update, first-match break, suffix-strip renaming) and its docstring conventions. Blueprint rewiring, untouched /config endpoints and a proportionate companion test suite are indistinguishable from ordinary repository evolution; the compromise carries no task-shaped scaffolding.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: Names every category of misplaced knowledge and demands no caller re-derive any, blocking partial moves; freezes exact conventions (prefix matching, .disabled suffix, double name split, mtime, start-disabled, identical disk results), preventing well-meaning redesign of matching; excludes /config endpoints and templates, preventing scope creep. It materially reduces wrong-direction, incomplete-cleanup and irrelevant-redesign risk while leaving implementation open.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Six distinct purposes need different code-supported decisions: raw-filename prefix matching; load-once-only-when-found with early return; loop-every-match bounded write that forbids early exit; I/O-free card derivation with two-level name split; directional rename mutations; creating a new site with no record instance in scope, plus scan-stamped mtime population. No one decision can serve two purposes.

localization_burden.evidence: Prompt names the app/api scope plus two orientation spots and admits they are not an inventory. Grepping record-field use, filename suffixes and startswith, plus reading the five small modules, surfaces all sites; classification is local, with delegating endpoints and the quiet create path left to notice. No aliases, callbacks or config selection.

repair_coordination.evidence: One shared rule must hold at several sites: set_state's renames produce filenames that cards and get_domain re-parse as enabled state; changing mutation without both derivations breaks toggle/display consistency. Matching at four sites is another shared rule, and content population is a third, but the rules run parallel rather than interlocking.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: Best uniform rules each complete at most one of eight locations: a path/matches pair cannot load find's content, express create's convention (no record instance exists), cover card derivation or the rename mechanism; reconnecting existing find cannot iterate all matches and adds needless read side effects; eager self-loading changes the listing's I/O. Under 20% for any single rule.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Two unchecked hidden paths: prefix-matching collisions (update and enable must touch every matching file; tests never create two sites sharing a prefix, so a first-match repair passes), and enable-on-already-enabled stripping '.conf' (untested; an idempotent repair silently diverges on disk). Staged lifecycle and second-request listing tests do cover other interactions.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
